title: REQ · A report writer persists validated, atomically written JSON reports
description: Context: no report package exists. Desired behavior: report.Writer{dir}.Write(Report) validates ID with store.ValidateID, creates the directory, and atomically writes indented JSON containing execution id, round id, status, attempts, error, started_at, finished_at and duration_ms. Expected result: a structured file per execution. Why: persisted execution summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid Report, When Write is called, Then <dir>/<id>.json decodes to the same field values
Given an invalid ID, When Write is called, Then it returns an error wrapping store.ErrInvalidID and the directory has no files
technical_constraints: Atomic temp file then rename like store.Save
